meta.revisionPolicy: Section 42 figures are provisional, then final; sectoral credit is provisional and revised the next month; NPAs and capital ratios are final on release. Seams disclosed, never joined: the 2019 sectoral classification, the July 2023 HDFC merger, the December 2025 reporting calendar.
meta.coverage: Bank credit by bank group and occupation, every quarter since June 2017
meta.note: RBI DBIE report 965 (data provider DP0), read from the local Data Bank mirror, as published. One display unit kept (ACTUALS). Amounts in ₹ crore. 9705 cells the source prints more than once with different values (2018-03-31, 2023-03-31, 2021-03-31, 2019-09-30 and other dates) are left out: we cannot tell which value is right.
